description: Search UK events (gigs, club nights, festivals, comedy, theatre, exhibitions). Filter by location (latitude+longitude+radius), keyword, category, and date window. Sorted by date or distance.

category.description: Category code: FEST, LIVE, CLUB, COMEDY, THEATRE, EXHIB, KIDS, BARPUB, LGB, ARTS, FILM, SPORT, DATE. Use the categories tool.

keyword.description: Keyword to match in event/venue/artist, e.g. "techno", "Adele".

latitude.description: Search-centre latitude (pair with longitude), e.g. 51.5074 for London.

longitude.description: Search-centre longitude (pair with latitude), e.g. -0.1278 for London.

radius.description: Search radius in miles (default 10, used with lat/long).

name: search_events
title: Search Events
